title: Baseline Comparator
description: The in-scope boundary: every discrete request the user made, and the constraints the agent operated under. Written by the orchestrating session BEFORE the auditor runs, so the auditor can judge each request against a fixed list instead of re-reading the scope with hindsight.

scope_source.description: Where the requests were lifted from (e.g. 'execution-artifact/scope.md turns 1-3').

requests.description: Every discrete, checkable thing the user asked for, in the order asked. Split compound sentences; do not merge, rank or judge.

id.description: R1, R2, … stable ids the ledger can cite.

request.description: The request, as close to the user's words as possible.

source_turn.description: The scope.md turn number it came from.

explicit_boundary.description: Any limit the user set on it ('only under ./.claude', 'do not commit').

constraints.description: What the agent was allowed and able to do. Used to decide whether an unmet request is out-of-scope (could never be done here) or pending (could be done, was not).

tools_available.description: Tool names the agent could call.

rules_in_effect.description: Standing rules (CLAUDE.md, RULES/*.md) that forbid or shape actions — banned deps, no-scan dirs, commit policy.

environment.description: Facts that bound what was possible: offline, no credentials, read-only mount, missing CLI.
